tools.name: base_token_safety_check
tools.description: Screens one ERC-20 token on Base or another EVM chain right before a swap and returns a verdict SAFE, CAUTION, DANGER or HONEYPOT, a safety score from 0 to 100 and a swap-eligibility decision with a recommended maximum slippage. It combines the GoPlus contract scan and a honeypot.is sell simulation

tools.name: evm_wallet_risk_check
tools.description: Screens one EVM address before an agent pays it, approves it or accepts funds from it: GoPlus address-security flags for phishing, theft, sanctions, money laundering, mixers, fake KYC, blacklists and malicious contracts created, rolled up into a risk verdict CLEAN, SUSPICIOUS or MALICIOUS with a sco
